reference_sql:
SELECT cal_date, weekday_name, event
FROM calendar
WHERE cal_date >= DATE '2025-11-01' AND cal_date <= DATE '2025-11-30' AND (event <> 'black_friday' OR event IS NULL)
alternatives:
SELECT cal_date, weekday_name, event
FROM calendar
WHERE cal_date BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30' AND (event IS NULL OR event <> 'black_friday')

SELECT cal_date, weekday_name, event
FROM calendar
WHERE (event <> 'black_friday' OR event IS NULL) AND cal_date >= '2025-11-01' AND cal_date < '2025-12-01'

SELECT cal_date, weekday_name, event
FROM calendar
WHERE cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-11-30' AND (NOT event = 'black_friday' OR event IS NULL)
